messages:
maya: Quick sync — can folks confirm where we are on the three new open models for catalog launch? archon-7b, raven-lite-3b, and willow-1.5b. Specifically: licensing OK, perf profiles landed, and owners for rollout?
ev an: archon-7b perf profiles are in my branch, need one more CI run. baseline numbers look good: 12ms/token p50 on p4d for seq512. PR: https://git.internal/rw/perf/archon-profiles (needs review). :eyes:
sanjay: infra note — the p4d runs are flaky atm, I'm cycling the infra nodes. If you need stable runs for canary, use the g5x2 pool (less noisy). I'll tag those runs with `stable-canary` label.
claire: product gating — licensing + perf regressions are blockers for the catalog launch next Wed. We need owners for rollout verification and a smoke checklist. maya, can you own the rollout checklist?
maya: I can own the rollout checklist. will add tasks for smoke tests + integration with catalog UI. tagging who does what in the checklist in a minute.
legal-jen: license update — archon-7b is MIT-compatible, raven-lite-3b has an ambiguous third-party dependency (see ticket RW-4617). I'm confirming upstream clarifications. willow-1.5b uses Apache-2.0, OK. ETA on archon/raven final sign-off: EOD tomorrow.
license-bot: Scanned licenses for submissions: archon-7b: MIT (ok), willow-1.5b: Apache-2.0 (ok), raven-lite-3b: POSSIBLE_ISSUE in subtree `third_party/optim` — see https://licenses.internal/RW-4617
evan: thanks @legal-jen. I'll hold off merging archon until sign-off. For raven-lite perf, initial profile is noisy because of fused-kernel fallback. Quick command I ran: `bench run --model raven-lite-3b --seq 256 --batch 8` — 18ms/token p50 on g5x2. I'll try quantized run next.
sanjay: FYI I created a short-lived node group for quant runs: `quant-sweep-2026-03-17`. Use it for consistency.
curation-bot: Intake checklist status: archon-7b metadata complete, model card draft in PR, raven-lite-3b metadata missing provenance note, willow-1.5b model card merged. Tickets: RW-4599 (archon metadata), RW-4617 (raven license), RW-4622 (perf profiles).
maya: action list I'll add to the rollout doc: 1) legal sign-off (jen) 2) perf CI green (evan + sanjay) 3) model card + metadata final (curation) 4) QA smoke (maya) 5) console route + canary (platform). I'll post link shortly.
claire: timeline check — if legal signs off tomorrow and evan gets one clean run, we can do a soft canary Thurs and full catalog push Fri. If anything slips, hold launch.
evan: pinging @sanjay for quant runs later today. I'll open the PR and mark it WIP until license is clear.
sanjay: ack, scheduling quant sweep at 17:30 PT. I'll post logs to the perf webhook.
maya: thanks all — I'll create the rollout checklist doc and assign tasks. evan, please paste the PR once opened. tagging this thread to the launch channel when checklist is ready. :thumbsup:
license-bot: Reminder: new license scans run nightly at 02:00 UTC. Subscribe: #license-alerts for immediate notifications.
